title: Verify: hover emission and overlay plate and action list unit tests
summary: Unit tests for objectHover emission and the overlay content from content definitions.
description: Test SceneObject hover callback, BootScene emission with Phaser mocked, and ObjectOverlay output from the real bedroom content.
acceptance_criteria: Plate and action list verified against content
technical_constraints: Fixtures come from game/src/content/worlds/the-boys-room/scenes/bedroom.yaml via runtime/content, not hard-coded payloads

steps.action: Reuse the Phaser mock pattern from frontend/tests/bootSceneSync.test.ts. Trigger the fake handle hover callback with true then false for the bookshelf; spy phaserToReact.emit and assert calls objectHover {id:'bookshelf'} then {id:null}.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneHover.test.ts

steps.action: Render ObjectOverlay with the real scene content from runtime/content, getSceneView(createInitialState) as view, layout {left:0,top:0,zoom:2,dpr:1}, activeId 'bookshelf'. Assert plate text equals the bookshelf content name upper-cased, buttons equal the action labels of the view upper-cased, and the plate sits at the anchorFor top y. Click a button and assert onAction spy called with ('bookshelf', id). Assert null render for activeId null and for missing layout.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/objectOverlay.test.tsx
